attacks.name: Breathing Gun
attacks.description: Fire your shotgun in bursts of two.

teamUpAbilities.name: Mr. Pool's Interdimensional Toy Box
teamUpAbilities.description: Deadpool hands Jeff the Land Shark a plushie with attitude. Jeff can spit it ahead where it'll continuously [blue]Taunt [/blue]nearby enemies and [blue]Block Vision[/blue], while allies in range enjoy a plush-powered healing party! Elsa's Living Bullet is empowered, also [blue]Taunting[/blue] nearby enemies and [blue]Blocking Vision[/blue]. She can recall the round, [green]healing[/green] herself based on the damage dealt.

abilities.name: Living Bullet
abilities.description: Fire a splintering shot that ricochets off surfaces towards nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Monster Dash
abilities.description: Dash in any direction, gaining [green]Bonus Health[/green].

abilities.name: Gun Launch
abilities.description: Dash ahead, then launch yourself and a target with a special gunshot. Press again while airborne to launch again.

abilities.name: Diablo Trap
abilities.description: Lay out a trap that snares an enemy, [orange]immobilizing[/orange] them. Once activated, press again to dash towards them.

passives.name: Instinct
passives.description: [blue]Instinct[/blue] reduces ability cooldowns. [blue]Instinct [/blue]is built by getting eliminations.

passives.name: Elephant Gun
passives.description: After using a movement ability, load your elephant gun for an [blue]empowered[/blue], piercing attack.

ultimate.name: Dinnertime
ultimate.description: Release the Glartrox, who charges at enemies straight ahead, [orange]immobilizing[/orange] them. Press again to recall him, finishing off with a devastating bite.
